Volunteers can sign up for regular shifts or come out anytime during shelter hours (Tue-Sun 10am-4pm) and, after a brief orientation by shelter staff, walk adoptable dogs in the marked areas; cat socializing is also offered. Under-18s need parental supervision.

Sign up on the shelter's site Call (970) 731-4771
